_comment: NVFP4 recipe for the Qwen3.5 family, consumed by tools/convert_hf_to_nvfp4.py (ModelOpt max calibration + HF export). W4A4: e2m1 values, 1x16 blocks with e4m3 block scales, plus fp32 per-tensor global scales (weight_scale_2 for weights, calibrated input_scale for activations). Same keep-list as qwen35_128blockfp8.json. sglang auto-detects the export as modelopt_fp4.
